articleTitle: Deep Learning for Medical Text Processing: BERT Model Fine-Tuning and Comparative Study
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Symposium on Sensor Technology and Control (ISSTC)
abstract: This paper proposes a medical literature summary generation method based on the BERT model to address the challenges brought by the current explosion of medical information. By fine-tuning and optimizing the BERT model, we develop an efficient summary generation system that can quickly extract key information from medical literature and generate coherent, accurate summaries. In the experiment, we compared various models, including Seq-Seq, Attention, Transformer, and BERT, and demonstrated that the improved BERT model offers significant advantages in the Rouge and Recall metrics. Furthermore, the results of this study highlight the potential of knowledge distillation techniques to further enhance model performance. The system has demonstrated strong versatility and efficiency in practical applications, offering a reliable tool for the rapid screening and analysis of medical literature.

articleTitle: Deep Learning with HM-VGG: AI Strategies for Multi-modal Image Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Symposium on Sensor Technology and Control (ISSTC)
abstract: This study introduces the Hybrid Multi-modal VGG (HM-VGG) model, a cutting-edge deep learning approach for the early diagnosis of glaucoma. The HM-VGG model utilizes an attention mechanism to process Visual Field (VF) data, enabling the extraction of key features that are vital for identifying early signs of glaucoma. Despite the common reliance on large annotated datasets, the HM-VGG model excels in scenarios with limited data, achieving remarkable results with small sample sizes. The model’s performance is underscored by its high metrics in Precision, Accuracy, and F1-Score, indicating its potential for real-world application in glaucoma detection. The paper also discusses the challenges associated with ophthalmic image analysis, particularly the difficulty of obtaining large volumes of annotated data. It highlights the importance of moving beyond single-modality data, such as VF or Optical Coherence Tomography (OCT) images alone, to a multimodal approach that can provide a richer, more comprehensive dataset. This integration of different data types is shown to significantly enhance diagnostic accuracy. The HMVGG model offers a promising tool for doctors, streamlining the diagnostic process and improving patient outcomes. Furthermore, its applicability extends to telemedicine and mobile healthcare, making diagnostic services more accessible. The research presented in this paper is a significant step forward in the field of medical image processing and has profound implications for clinical ophthalmology.

articleTitle: Simulation Design of Class IV Flextensional Transducer
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Symposium on Sensor Technology and Control (ISSTC)
abstract: Class IV flextensional transducers are often used in underwater acoustic equipment due to their low-frequency and high-power characteristics. This paper uses COMSOL finite element software to simulate and optimize the electro-acoustic performance of class IV flextensional transducer, and conducts simulation analysis on the pre-stressed shell, which has guiding significance for the production and assembly of transducers.

articleTitle: Hazardous Gas Sensor Correction System Based on Linear Regression Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Symposium on Sensor Technology and Control (ISSTC)
abstract: In this paper, the $\mathbf{C O}$ sensor correction is completed in Wanliu area as an example, so as to achieve accurate measurement of CO in Wanliu area. First, we extracted CO data from the Wanliu area and integrated the data collected by the actual sensors. Subsequently, we calculated the root mean square error between the predicted and actual values to evaluate the accuracy of the prediction model. The results show that we have successfully established a comprehensive CO concentration dataset and derived a reference value for $C O$ concentration. Through the analysis of the integrated data set, we can further understand the relationship between $C O$ concentration and other variables, such as temperature and humidity, and predict the trend of CO concentration. These findings provide valuable information for understanding the $C O$ pollution situation, analyzing the relevant factors, and making corresponding decisions. This research has important implications for environmental protection and public health, and provides a basis for future research.

articleTitle: Multi-Target Tracking with Occlusion Handling: A Fusion of Mean Shift and Unscented Kalman Filtering
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Symposium on Sensor Technology and Control (ISSTC)
abstract: This paper proposes a multi-target tracking method that combines the mean shift algorithm and Unscented Kalman Filter (UKF). When a spatial target is temporarily occluded, the trajectory is predicted by Unscented Kalman Filter, and the trajectories of the detected and predicted targets are correlated using the Hungarian algorithm to achieve efficient tracking. The experimental results show that the improved algorithm is not only able to track the temporarily occluded target, but also has a MOTPA value of 91.754% and a MOTP of 93.237%.

articleTitle: Research on Remote Maintenance Method of Pump Turbine Main Shaft Condition in Pumped Storage Power Plant
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Symposium on Sensor Technology and Control (ISSTC)
abstract: In pumped storage power plant, the damage of pump turbine main shaft seal, the operation status of pumped storage unit is relatively complex, and the wide range of hydraulic fluctuation during the switching process of working conditions has produced serious threat to the stable operation of overflow pipeline, unit and other equipment. Therefore, this paper proposes a study on the remote overhaul method of pump turbine main shaft condition in pumped storage power plants. Firstly, the model mechanism of pumped storage unit is explored and the measurement signal is processed to carry out the quantitative analysis of the system operation state, and to achieve the feature extraction of the state signal and intelligent fault diagnosis. Secondly, the real-time operation data of the spindle is obtained by screening the appropriate spindle state indicators and using the data acquisition system. The connection between the virtual spindle and the system is established to achieve real-time synchronous operation between the virtual model and the physical entity. Finally, design the equipment fault early warning process based on SOM algorithm, and use the operation data to verify the example, to provide guarantee for the normal operation of the equipment. The experimental results show that through the remote maintenance method, the status of the pump turbine main shaft can be monitored in real time, and potential faults can be detected and dealt with in a timely manner, so as to improve the operation efficiency and safety of the unit.

articleTitle: Ultra-Sensitive Anti-Parity-Time-Symmetric Wireless Sensor Based on Unidirectional Couplings
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Symposium on Sensor Technology and Control (ISSTC)
abstract: The coupled LC resonators satisfying parity-time (PT) symmetry or anti-PT (APT) symmetry can be utilized as highly sensitive sensors if calibrating them at exceptional points (EPs) in advance. In practice, however, the existing VNA-free and wireless PT- and APT-symmetric systems are restricted by the vague EP position and the requirement of imaginary-value couplings, respectively. These issues are addressed by the proposed novel APT-symmetric wireless sensor, constructed by four coupled LC resonators. A pair of unidirectional and opposite real-value couplings is implemented to achieve the wireless sensing functionality. The property of different numbers of operating frequencies at the APT-symmetric and -broken states is utilized to calibrate the system at the EP. The time-domain working mode avoids using VNAs to sweep the frequency. The system behavior is analytically analyzed and validated through simulations. The simulated results show that the frequency deviation response to the resonant frequency perturbation $\left(\varepsilon_{\omega}\right)$ features an ultra-high sensitivity, $\sim\left|\varepsilon_{\omega}\right|^{0.5}$.

articleTitle: The UKF Train Combination Positioning Information Fusion Algorithm Based on Variational Bayesian Estimation
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Symposium on Sensor Technology and Control (ISSTC)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of inaccurate positioning caused by satellite signal interference during train operation, a combination positioning model of BDS/INS was established, and the system state equation and observation equation were established respectively. This paper presents a method of untracked Kalman filter (UKF) information fusion train location based on variable decibels bayesian estimation. Firstly, the nonlinear variable bayesian estimation with inverse Gamma distribution is extended to UKF algorithm framework to form a variable Bayesian UKF. Then it is applied to the BDS/INS train positioning system. The simulation results show that compared with the traditional positioning methods, the proposed algorithm can significantly reduce the positioning errors in complex environments, and fully meet the basic requirements of modern high-speed railway for train positioning accuracy and reliability. Therefore, the algorithm not only provides a new solution for train positioning technology, but also lays a solid foundation for ensuring the safety of train operation and improving the transportation efficiency, and has broad application prospects and important practical significance.

articleTitle: Research on a Modbus-Based Data Acquisition System for Laser Distance Sensors
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Symposium on Sensor Technology and Control (ISSTC)
abstract: This paper focuses on the design of a data acquisition system for the VL53L1 laser distance sensor used in the laboratory’s active reflector experimental platform. The system employs an STM32 microcontroller as the main controller for the VL53L1 sensor, and connects to the host computer via an RS485 bus. By porting the FreeModbus protocol stack onto the STM32, Modbus communication is implemented. The Modbus Poll tool is used on the host computer to test connectivity and send data acquisition commands. This system effectively transmits sensor data (such as current readings) to the host computer, enabling the collection and upload of sensor parameters.

articleTitle: Non-contact Acoustic Detection Technology for Bridge Structural Damage Based on High Frequency Vibration Signal Reconstruction Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Symposium on Sensor Technology and Control (ISSTC)
abstract: To improve the accuracy of bridge damage location detection results, a non-contact acoustic detection technology for bridge structural damage based on high-frequency vibration signal reconstruction algorithm is proposed. Based on orthogonal complement pyramid decomposition and waveform feature parameters, the signal is subjected to series orthogonal subspace decomposition and reconstruction. After denoising, a linear mixed model is constructed using a high-frequency vibration signal reconstruction algorithm. By utilizing the reconstructed signal features and combining them with the propagation characteristics of sound waves, a coupling relationship between displacement and wave direction is established. And in the bending wave mode, the frequency is classified by integrating the displacement order derivative, and the damage is located by superimposing the wave state, achieving non-contact acoustic detection of bridge structural damage. The experimental results show that the non-contact acoustic detection of bridge structure damage using the method designed in this paper has good accuracy and practical application value.

Author Keywords: High frequency vibration signal reconstruction algorithm

articleTitle: Experimental Study on Flexural Stiffness of CFRP Box Beam Based on Fiber Bragg Grating Sensor
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Symposium on Sensor Technology and Control (ISSTC)
abstract: In this paper, through the three-point flexural experiment, the flexural stiffness of the box beam with 5 kinds of layers with different 0° is obtained by using the fiber grating sensor, and the results are compared with the theoretical and simulation values, it shows that: the higher the 0° ratio is, the greater the flexural stiffness is; the simulation of the three-point flexural is reasonable by Abaqus, the FEA is reliable for the design and optimization of the composite box beam based on the flexural stiffness.

articleTitle: Pulse Wave Measurement and Analysis Based on A Bandage-Based Pressure Sensing System
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Symposium on Sensor Technology and Control (ISSTC)
abstract: To address the shortcomings of strong subjectivity and difficult control of pulse-taking pressure in current pulse wave measurement, this paper designs a bandage-based pressure sensing system (BPSS). The BPSS consists of elastic bandages, four flexible pressure sensors, hardware circuits and a user interface on computer. It is capable of simultaneously measuring pressure distribution along the bandage as well as the real-time pulse waveforms. This paper calibrates the properties of the sensor through piecewise fitting with a power-exponential function, achieving a measurement accuracy of 0.1 mmHg in the pressure range of 35$\mathrm{mmHg} \sim 220 \mathrm{mmHg}$. Based on the BPSS, an effective filtering and period segmentation method in pulse wave processing are proposed. Accordingly, the relationship among pulse waveforms index $\mathrm{H} 4 / \mathrm{H} 1$, pulse-taking pressure, and the blood pressure of the subjects has been investigated. This BPSS proposes a method to measure, process and analyze the pulse waveforms, providing references for estimating the blood pressure relying on pulse waveforms in a convenient way.

articleTitle: Comparative Experimental Study of Infrared Distance Sensor and Ultrasonic Distance Sensor
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Symposium on Sensor Technology and Control (ISSTC)
abstract: Ranging Sensors Are Increasingly Utilized In Automatic Navigation Systems, Smart Home Devices, Robots, And Other Industries Due To The Rapid Advancement Of Automation Technology And The Widespread Adoption Of Intelligent Products. It Is Crucial To Select The Appropriate Ranging Sensor For Various Application Scenarios Due To The Distinct Advantages And Limitations Of Different Sensor Types. In This Paper, Sliding Filter, Mean Value Method, Control Variable Method, And Multi-Sensor Fusion Are Used To Reduce The Measurement Error, And The Performance Of Infrared And Ultrasonic Distance Sensors Under Different Conditions Is Compared. An In-Depth Comparative Analysis Of The System Revealed That The Infrared Sensor’s Performance Is Influenced By Light Intensity, With Stronger Light Resulting In Better Performance. On The Other Hand, The Ultrasonic Sensor’s Performance Is Impacted By Temperature And Humidity, With Higher Temperatures And Lower Humidity Levels Leading To Improved Performance. This Paper Aims To Explore The Effectiveness Of These Two Sensors Under Different Conditions And Multi-Sensor Fusion Technology Through Experimental Research. The Insights Gained From This Study Are Intended To Provide Practical Reference For Engineers And Researchers In Related Fields.

articleTitle: The Distributed Generation Power Selling Model Based on Floating Rate
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Symposium on Sensor Technology and Control (ISSTC)
abstract: With the rapid development of Chinese power-system reform started in 2015 and distributed generation (DG), focus has been placed on promoting power consumption from DG in the near region. In this paper, firstly, a DG power selling model based on floating rate is designed, which achieves an interaction among investment, floating rate and power sale. Secondly, three modules—investment, floating rate function, and power sales transaction—are designed using system dynamics (SD). Regarding the floating rate function module, the interaction has been established among guidance consulting services, loan interest rate, and power consumption rate in the near region. Thirdly, comparative analysis model of stakeholders’ benefits is established, which is used to demonstrate the feasibility of the power selling mode. Finally, an empirical analysis of DG was conducted. The results show that the model can promote the nearby power consumption but also achieve a win-win among DG investors, power grid enterprises, and users.

articleTitle: The Simulation of AC Power Grid Detection By MEMS Microcoils
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Symposium on Sensor Technology and Control (ISSTC)
abstract: Smart grid monitoring plays a pivotal role in optimizing power distribution and minimizing energy wastage, especially relying on current detection methods. The traditional current detection device was bulky, costly and inconvenient to install. This paper was aim to study the theoretical feasibility of alternating current detection of based microcoil fabricated by MEMS technology for Power grid monitoring. The power transmission line and microcoil model was established, and the influence of different coil arrangement on the detection current was studied. The simulation results verified that the detection of alternating power grid based on MEMS microcoil was feasible. Driven by an alternating current of 500 amperes at a frequency of 50 Hertz, the microcoils arranged in an array can induce a current of up to 68 microampere at a certain distance, and the detection performance can be further improved by adjusting the array and placement mode. The results of simulation calculations provided a certain theoretical guidance for the design and fabrication of current sensors based on MEMS microcoils.

articleTitle: Research on Target Detection for Waste Classification Based on Improved YOLOv5
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Symposium on Sensor Technology and Control (ISSTC)
abstract: In order to further improve the accurate recognition of targets by a waste sorting robot, this paper proposes a robot target detection algorithm based on improved YOLOv5. By using CoordConv convolution and introducing the SENet attention mechanism, the acquisition and recognition of target information is improved. Through a large number of data comparisons, the improved algorithm proposed in this paper improves the accuracy by 5.3% compared with the traditional algorithm. It can effectively improve the efficiency of rubbish collection and classification.

articleTitle: A Carbon-Based FET-type Gas Sensor with Tenax TA Screening Unit for The Selective Detection of Benzene and Toluene
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Symposium on Sensor Technology and Control (ISSTC)
abstract: Volatile organic compounds are crucial detection targets in the field of environmental monitoring. However, in the complex gas environments, gas sensing devices often face challenges in effectively identifying and detecting target gases within mixed gas mixtures due to cross-sensitivity to different gases. In this work, a carbon-based FET-type gas sensor with $\mathrm{ZnO} / \mathrm{WS}_{2}$ nano-composites as the gate material and Tenax TA as screening unit has been developed for the selective detection of benzene and toluene. The proposed gas sensor shows excellent gas sensitivity and has a certain response to various gases at room temperature, among which the response to benzene is the highest. Tenax TA particles are used as a screening unit to successfully separate and detect benzene in air mixture at optimum heating temperature.The experimental results show that the sensor has wonderful selection performance. It is expected that this strategy can provide a meaningful guide for the development of highperformance gas sensors that can effectively identify and detect target gas in complex gas environments.

articleTitle: An Ionospheric TEC Prediction Method Based on Convolution Operation and LSTM Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Symposium on Sensor Technology and Control (ISSTC)
abstract: The total electron content (TEC) is an important physical quantity of ionosphere, which has a great influence on navigation, positioning, communication and radar. The short-term prediction of TEC has been a hot research in the field, and TEC prediction research based on time series prediction method, such as Long Short-term Memory (LSTM) neural network, has made great progress. In this paper, the characteristic data of ionospheric TEC after convolution operation, together with ionospheric TEC, day of the year and local time, are used as inputs to construct a LSTM neural network to predict ionospheric TEC. Simulation results showed that compared with other simple LSTM neural networks, the improved ionospheric TEC prediction method based on convolution operation and LSTM neural network in this paper can improve the prediction accuracy of ionospheric TEC to a certain extent, can effectively improve the accuracy of TEC prediction.

articleTitle: Hysteresis Modeling of Piezoelectric Actuator Based on GCBBW Model
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Symposium on Sensor Technology and Control (ISSTC)
abstract: This paper proposes a Generalized Circular Basis (GCBBW) model for tracking errors caused by hysteresis open-loop nonlinearity in piezoelectric actuator systems (PEAs). Firstly, it is explained that the BW (Bouc Wen) model lacks sufficient description of the two end characteristics of PEA hysteresis. Then, the introduction of axis degenerate circular differentiation replaces the original class exponential differentiation, changing the shape of the BW model itself and improving the model’s ability to describe PEA hysteresis. At the same time, a six stage control function was designed to distinguish between the initial stage and the stable stage. Finally, a hierarchical genetic algorithm with embedded particle swarm optimization was proposed, which uses the search results of the inner layer algorithm as the fitness of the outer layer algorithm to improve search efficiency. The experimental results show that the proposed GCCBW model has a relative root mean square error of less than 0.17% under 1-20 Hz sine wave input, demonstrating the effectiveness of the GCBBW model and the hierarchical genetic algorithm embedded in particle swarm optimization.

articleTitle: The Simulation Study of High-Sensitivity GMR (Giant Magnetoresistive) Biosensors
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Symposium on Sensor Technology and Control (ISSTC)
abstract: GMR biosensors, due to their simple detection and low background noise, have a broad application prospect in the fields of biomedical detection, etc. However, there is still room for improvement in the sensitivity of current GMR biosensors. We study the high-sensitivity enhancement method of GMR biosensors using a magnetic flux concentrator through simulation calculations, and investigate the impact of factors such as the distribution of magnetic labels on the performance of GMR sensors. Our work provides a theoretical and technical framework for GMR chip design and offers a promising tool for advancing biomedical detection technologies.

articleTitle: Improved Localization Algorithm Based on MultiSensor Fusion for Shopping Robots
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Symposium on Sensor Technology and Control (ISSTC)
abstract: To address the issues of indoor shopping robots being unable to locate their initial position when starting from arbitrary locations and map mismatches during navigation, an improved ORB-SLAM3 positioning system that fuses LiDAR technology with RGB-D has been designed. First, LiDAR provides limited positioning information, whereas depth cameras offer a broader range of positional data. Therefore, a system that fuses LiDAR with RGB-D cameras is proposed, introducing visual information to merge visual feature maps with two-dimensional grid maps, enabling mode switching between LiDAR and visual sensor positioning. Secondly, the 6-DoF in the visual algorithm is simplified to 3-DoF, effectively reducing positioning time. Finally, through positioning experiments, it has been validated that the positioning accuracy with mode switching improves by 58.5% compared to using LiDAR alone, the positioning time accuracy improves by 35.13% compared to the ORB-SLAM3 algorithm, and the positioning error accuracy improves by $\mathbf{2 6. 4 2 \%}$ compared to the ORB-SLAM3 algorithm, demonstrating the effectiveness of the improved positioning algorithm.

articleTitle: Research on High-Frequency Square Wave Control for Sensorless Motor Drives
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Symposium on Sensor Technology and Control (ISSTC)
abstract: The rotor position information, which is typically obtained through encoders or rotating transformers, is relied upon by the traditional motor vector control system to achieve precise field-oriented control. Given considerations such as cost and installation position, sensorless vector control technology has emerged as a new research focus. The cost and algorithmic complexity of traditional sine wave injection motor control are relatively high. To address these issues, a sensorless control technique is introduced in this article, which utilizes highfrequency square wave signals for injection, departing from the conventional practice of employing sine wave injections. This effectively eliminates the need for filters in traditional control and significantly streamlines the process of signal processing for estimating rotor positions. The results of hardware testing experiments indicate that sensorless control, with the introduction of elevated-frequency rectangular waveforms, is more dynamic and easier to implement, achieving accurate motor speed control with small position errors.

articleTitle: Phenotyping for the Real-time Detection of Plant Leaf Stress Using Infrared Thermal Imaging Sensors
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Symposium on Sensor Technology and Control (ISSTC)
abstract: Plant stress in California has become a significant issue in recent years due to a combination of drought, malnutrition, and infections. There is an urgent need to develop a cost-effective, time-efficient, and reliable method to address this issue. This paper aims to develop a method of using infrared thermal imaging techniques to detect stress in plant leaves. The design of experiment (DOE) is divided into two phases. Phase one involved selecting three types of plants that represent significant stress factors in California - drought, infections, and malnutrition. The plants selected were raspberry, cherries, corn tomato, eggplant, and oleander. For each type of plant, three areas were chosen that each represented a stage of the plant’s stress: no stress (healthy), early stress, and fully stressed. Twenty points of surface thermal temperature were taken from each area of the plant leaf, and t-tests were conducted to calculate the p-value. The experiment indicates that thermal imaging techniques can be used for early detection in raspberry (drought and malnutrition) (p< 0.0001), cherries (drought) (p= 0.2996), corn (drought) (p< 0.0001), tomato (infections) (p< 0.0001), and eggplant (infections) (p< 0.0001), oleander (infections) (p< 0.0001). Phase two focused on developing a method to monitor the progressive development of plant stress throughout the entire drought process. A corresponding thermal model was built to understand the stress mechanism better for management of irrigation scheduling and plant phenotyping. The plants chosen were gardenia, tomato, and cucumber. In addition to recognizing thermal patterns throughout the process, an image processor was also created by code to calculate the percentage of healthy versus diseased area of the plant. The immediate application for this research is that it offers an advanced, non-invasive method for early detection of various plant stressors. This provides an effective solution for farmers to combat climate change and reduce plant losses due to infections, promoting much more sustainable agriculture.

articleTitle: Optimizing Atmospheric Correction through Parallel Acceleration: Reflection Accuracy Analysis of GF-5B Satellite Hyperspectral Sensor Data
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Symposium on Sensor Technology and Control (ISSTC)
abstract: The GF-5B satellite is equipped with seven payloads, including a Visible shortwave infrared hyperspectral camera (AHSI), which can simultaneously conduct comprehensive observations of both land and the atmosphere, offering broad application prospects. This article evaluates the quality of GF-5B AHSI data surface reflectance using three evaluation indicators: correlation coefficient, root mean square error, and spectral cosine angle, and compares it with ASD measured spectral data. The results indicate that the GF-5B AHSI load can effectively identify surface mineral information such as kaolinite and chlorite, and has outstanding application capabilities in mineral information extraction in mining areas, geological environment monitoring in mines, and fine extraction of mineral information in mines.

articleTitle: Design of Integrated Control System for Industrial Boilers Based on PCS7
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Symposium on Sensor Technology and Control (ISSTC)
abstract: This study aims to design and simulate the integrated automation and optimized control of a natural circulation boiler using the Siemens Process Control System (PCS7). The research object is the natural circulation boiler within the Synthesized Multi-function Process Control training device (SMPT-1000). By thoroughly analyzing the boiler’s process flow and based on safety requirements and process parameter demands, a comprehensive control system was designed, including Continuous Function Control (CFC) program designed for control loops, Sequential Function Chart (SFC) program designed for cold start-up and shutdown, and the Windows Control Center (WinCC) monitoring interface. The results show that the control system in this study achieved excellent control performance in many aspects, providing a practical solution for the automation control of industrial boilers.

articleTitle: Solving Actuator Selection Problems with Q-learning
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Symposium on Sensor Technology and Control (ISSTC)
abstract: In modern large-scale radio telescopes, active reflector control technology is commonly employed. For example, the Five-hundred-meter Aperture Spherical Telescope (FAST), the largest single-dish radio telescope in the world, features a reflective surface composed of multiple sub-panels. Each sub-panel typically requires three micro-displacement actuators to provide support and facilitate rapid adjustments. These actuators enable precise control of the sub-panel’s pitch, yaw, and translation, ensuring the high-precision alignment of the overall reflective surface. This paper proposes a methodology for selecting the most reliable actuator from a range of available options. To address the optimal selection of actuators in active reflector control systems, the $\mathbf{Q}$ learning algorithm is employed. The selected actuator’s performance is validated through physical experiments conducted on an active reflective surface control module, which is integrated into the active reflective surface measurement and control digital twin experimental platform of the Joint Laboratory. The final actuator selection is subsequently applied to a physical system implementation. Compared with traditional selection methods, the proposed approach demonstrates improved selection efficiency, accelerates project completion, and significantly reduces costs associated with trial-and-error processes.

articleTitle: Smart Sensor for Online Vibration Monitoring of Hydropower Dam Based on Butterfly MEMS Accelerometer
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Symposium on Sensor Technology and Control (ISSTC)
abstract: Aiming at the increasing demand for smart sensor in online vibration monitoring of hydropower dam, a smart sensor is developed using MEMS sensing technology and distributed networking technology. Equipped with a high performance Cortex-A55 SOC and a low power Cortex-M3 MCU, the smart sensor adopts a novel software and hardware architecture to achieve real-time vibration monitoring and edge computing. In order to achieve self-identification, self-description, and interoperability of the smart sensor, a tailored IEC61850 communication model is used. The vibration of the hydropower dam is sensed by three single axis butterfly MEMS accelerometers inside the smart sensor. Experiments were undertaken to verify the performance of the smart sensor within the range of 0.5 Hz to 50 Hz. A sensitivity amplitude linearity of 3 % and sensitivity frequency response of 5% is achieved.

articleTitle: A Method for Adapting Power System Sensors under the Dianhong IOT Operating System
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Symposium on Sensor Technology and Control (ISSTC)
abstract: Conventional power system sensor adaptation methods are mainly based on adaptation parameter optimization, which may fall into the problem of local optimization due to the influence of parameters. Therefore, a power system sensor adaptation method is designed under the Dianhong IOT operating system. The power system sensor adaptation node is selected, and the sensor data is converted into the data format that can be understood and processed by the Dianhong IOT operating system. Establish the power system sensor adaptation mechanism, define the communication protocol between the adapted nodes and sensors, data conversion rules, error handling and other principles. Generate the adapted integration program of Dianhong IOT operating system to manage the access of adapted nodes, control the operation of the adapted mechanism, and process the sensor data, so as to meet the demand of adapted sensors of the power system. Comparison experiments are used to verify that the method has a better adaptation effect and can be applied in real life.

articleTitle: Research on Meteorological Monitoring and Early Warning with Quantum Lidar
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Symposium on Sensor Technology and Control (ISSTC)
abstract: The rapid development of quantum Lidar technology has brought new opportunities for meteorological monitoring and disaster warning. This paper discusses the use of quantum lidar for multi-volume scanning, studies the detection technology of atmospheric pollution based on quantum radar, and detects the extinction coefficient and depolarization ratio distribution of atmospheric horizontal paths through lidar to achieve the detection of atmospheric pollutants with high spatial and temporal resolution. The continuous spatial and temporal distribution observation data of various cloud features obtained by quantum radar is also discussed. The technology of thunderstorm identification and thunderstorm disaster warning is studied. Research on feasibility and algorithm of meteorological monitoring and disaster warning with high spatio-temporal resolution. The research shows that quantum Lidar can provide more accurate and real-time meteorological data, which is helpful to improve the accuracy of meteorological forecast, and then effectively conduct disaster early warning.

articleTitle: Design of Satellite-Ground Integrated Universal Test Scheme for Spacecraft Navigation Receivers
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Symposium on Sensor Technology and Control (ISSTC)
abstract: Spacecraft navigation receiver is an integral part of spacecraft tracking and orbit measurement subsystem, and its reliability is crucial for the stable operation of spacecraft in orbit. However, in the stage of spacecraft comprehensive testing, there are some problems in the existing technology of testing spacecraft navigation receivers, such as the inability to form a closed loop, high manual participation, and low test efficiency. In this paper, a universal architecture of a satellite-ground integrated spacecraft navigation receiver test system is designed. Ground-based test equipment and telemetry data are combined to realize real-time closed-loop test and interpretation of navigation receiver. A navigation receiver test and evaluation technology oriented toward simulated flight missions is proposed, and a stability evaluation of long-term operations is realized. The method proposed in this paper is successfully applied to a spacecraft comprehensive test, which solves the practical problems and improves test efficiency.

articleTitle: Simulation and Experimental Study of a Floating Buffer Based on Bernoulli Equation
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Symposium on Sensor Technology and Control (ISSTC)
abstract: Floating buffer technology is one of the effective ways to improve the speed of mechanism movement, reduce recoil resistance, enhance the accuracy of mechanism movement, and achieve lightweight technology. The article establishes the motion differential equation of the mechanism under continuous instantaneous impact for a high-speed floating buffer. Based on the Bernoulli equation, a calculation method for hydraulic resistance during recoil and recoil processes considering changes in needle valve flow rate was established. Solving the differential equation of the recoil process of the buffer using high-precision ordinary differential equations. Combined with experimental testing, the established buffer model was validated. The results showed that the maximum displacement of the buffer after calculation had an error of 3.7% compared to the test results, which verified the accuracy of the simulation analysis model and provided important reference for conducting research on similar problems.

articleTitle: Terahertz Refractive Index Sensor Based on Tunable Graphene Metamaterial Absorber
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Symposium on Sensor Technology and Control (ISSTC)
abstract: A terahertz refractive index sensor constructed with graphene metamaterial absorber has been proposed. The sensor features a patterned graphene structure, consisting of an independent circular ring and a special structure formed by intersecting cross and square patterns. Under normal incidence of TM and TE polarized light, the sensor exhibits a low-frequency peak at 1.55 THz with maximum absorption rates of $\mathbf{9 9. 4 5 \%}$ and a high-frequency peak at 3.83 THz with maximum absorption rates of $\mathbf{9 9. 5 0 \%}$. The quality factors (Q factor) of the two peaks are 31 and 65, respectively. Unlike traditional metal sensors, the absorption peaks of this sensor can achieve dynamic tunability through adjusting the graphene’s Fermi level. By varying the analyte’s thickness and refractive index, the maximum sensitivity of the two absorption peaks can reach $495 \mathrm{GHz} / \mathrm{RIU}$ and 895 $\mathrm{GHz} /$ RIU. The corresponding figures of merit (FOM) are 9.9 and 15.2, respectively. The sensor proposed here are applied to detect hemoglobin biomolecule content and has shown excellent sensing performance in our simulations. Therefore, the present work has broad potential for applications in biomedical and medical diagnostic fields.

articleTitle: Research on the Smoke Alarm Based on DSP System
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Symposium on Sensor Technology and Control (ISSTC)
abstract: The focus of this research paper is to develop a smoke detector system for cities that provides timely warnings about smoke and identifies the type of smoke to prevent potential fire hazards. The system uses MQ-2 gas sensor to detect smoke in the hardware part and uses NE555 timer to convert the sensor data into logic output to trigger the alarm when smoke is detected. MQ-2 is connected to the trigger pin of NE555, the threshold pin is connected to VCC, the positive terminal of the buzzer is connected to VCC, and the negative terminal is connected to the output of NE555. When smoke is detected, NE555 outputs a low signal, activating the buzzer. The smoke data is then processed through digital-to-analog conversion (ADC), allowing the one-dimensional data of smoke to be transformed into the frequency domain for analysis. This analysis employs Discrete Fourier Transform (DTF) and Hanning Windows (Hanning Windows), Rectangle Windows (Rectangle Windows) to identify the type of smoke. This design is robust, anti-interference, low cost, easy to install and maintain, and suitable for use in urban high-rise buildings and other application scenarios.

articleTitle: Simulation design and optimization of low-frequency electromagnetic sensor
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Symposium on Sensor Technology and Control (ISSTC)
abstract: Currently, ferromagnetic substrates such as tank bodies, pressure equipment, and high-pressure pipelines have potential safety hazards such as corrosion and cracks. Based on the principle of low-frequency electromagnetic detection, this paper uses simulation analysis to study the effect of the shape and size of the magnetic coil core on the magnetic induction intensity, constructs a three-dimensional finite element simulation model of the low-frequency electromagnetic sensor, and analyzes the impact of the number of turns of the receiving coil and the diameter of the core on the sensor’s detection signal through ablation experiments. After optimizing the parameters of the excitation coil and the receiving coil of the sensor, the intensity of the received signal of the sensor has increased by 13%, effectively improving the detection performance of the sensor.

articleTitle: Research on the Scoring Algorithm of Throwing Effect Based on Visual Motion Sensing Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Symposium on Sensor Technology and Control (ISSTC)
abstract: Vision-based human-computer interaction technology, namely visual motion sensing technology, has made many application achievements. In terms of entertainment, there are many pioneering applications. Aiming at the combination of visual motion sensing technology and throwing game, this paper studies the throwing scoring algorithm of the motion sensing throwing target system for entertainment.In RGB-D target detection, get the detection frame coordinates of the face and hand at the end of the throwing, extract the depth information of the center point of the detection box, calculate the movement speed of the center point of the hand at the end of the throwing, compared with the lowest throwing speed, determine whether the throwing missed the target, and the distance between the center point is calculated, and the accuracy of the throwing is judged according to the distance of the two. A difficulty coefficient is designed according to the distance of the throw, comparing the difficulty coefficient to the number of cycles in last throw are multiplied to give the final score. The effectiveness of the algorithm is verified by comparing experiments with real throwing situations.

articleTitle: Study on Linearity of Time Difference Flux Gate Sensor under Different Incentives
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Symposium on Sensor Technology and Control (ISSTC)
abstract: With the vigorous development of modern high-end precision instrument technology, the accuracy and efficiency of automatic testing systems are experiencing unprecedented improvements. The foundation of this technological advancement is deeply rooted in the collaborative development of multiple fields, including the continuous optimization of sensor technology and the continuous innovation of intelligent control technology. Every leap in these fields has laid a solid foundation for building more accurate and efficient automatic testing systems. Flux gate sensor is a highly sensitive magnetic field measurement device widely used in industries, automobiles, medical and scientific research fields. The basic principle is to rely on a pair of materials with high magnetic permeability to perceive the magnetic field by the change in magnetic flux generated under the action of an external magnetic field. This article uses triangular wave excitation and sine wave excitation. The saturation current of the magnetic core is amplified by a differential amplifier circuit and the data is read by an oscilloscope. The time difference is calculated by programming in LabVIEW to explore the linearity of the measured magnetic field and time difference of the time difference type flux gate.

articleTitle: Analysis and visualization of lagrange flow field based on C3D and C4D
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Symposium on Sensor Technology and Control (ISSTC)
abstract: This study addresses the challenges of converting Eulerian flow fields into Lagrangian fields in the post-processing of CFD simulations for tidal flow analysis. A Lagrangian flow field analysis and visualization method is developed, integrating C3D for rapid interpolation calculations and C4D for efficient rendering of fluid particle trajectories. Key technologies include fast Lagrangian field analysis using C3D, dynamic particle supplementation to prevent blank areas in the computational domain, and a C4D-based programmatic display technique to manage the rendering of large-scale fluid particles. This method significantly improves computational efficiency and visual representation speed. The proposed solution was successfully applied to the Fourth Harbor Basin Project of Jingtang Port in Tangshan, demonstrating its effectiveness in converting CFD results into dynamic visual outputs and providing valuable insights for similar engineering applications.

articleTitle: Investigation of Low-frequency Noise Source Localization Technology for Transformers Using a Vector Microphone
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Symposium on Sensor Technology and Control (ISSTC)
abstract: Monitoring and localizing the sources of low-frequency noise are crucial for diagnosing transformer sound faults; however, they present significant challenges. This study explored the capabilities of acoustic vector microphones in localizing noise sources in transformers. First, a signal processing model for acoustic source localization using vector microphones was established. Subsequently, simulation analyses were conducted. Finally, experimental validation of the proposed method was performed. The proposed approach showed promise for providing new acoustic measurement methods for transformer fault diagnosis.

articleTitle: Research on Flow Resistance Characteristics of Turbine Flow Sensors
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Symposium on Sensor Technology and Control (ISSTC)
abstract: This study investigates the application of turbine flow sensors in small-diameter fuel pipelines, focusing on their flow resistance characteristics. An experimental platform was constructed utilizing a dual-rotor turbine flow sensor to explore the impact of fluid flow on sensor performance. Experimental results indicate that within a certain flow range, the flow resistance coefficient of turbine flow sensors in small-diameter pipelines initially increases with pressure loss and then decreases. This behavior may lead to a reduction in fuel supply pressure, adversely affecting the measurement accuracy of engine fuel consumption. Through a comprehensive analysis of experimental data under varying flow and pressure conditions, this study evaluates the effectiveness and safety of turbine flow sensors in measuring fuel consumption for aviation engines.

articleTitle: A Fall Detection Approach Based on ACF for WI-FI CSI Against Co-Channel Interference
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Symposium on Sensor Technology and Control (ISSTC)
abstract: Fall detection is an important research for wireless sensing to recognize human activities. WiFi CSI has emerged as an effective solution to the fall detection due to its advantages of being non-invasive, privacy-preserving. However, commercial WiFi devices are often deployed in complex electromagnetic environments, where interference caused by channel overlap among WiFi devices is especially pronounced. This interference may significantly impact the accuracy of fall detection.. In order to solve the above problems, the paper discusses the effect of cochannel interference on the actual CSI. Then the CSI data were utilized to obtain an improved signal-to-noise ratio (SNR). This approach enables us to establish a mapping relationship between the ratio of dynamic power associated with falls and noise power in the presence of co-channel interference (CCI), as well as the characteristics of human fall movements. According to the experiments, the approach was able to achieve an accuracy of $\mathbf{9 7 \%}$ for fall detection under CCI.

articleTitle: Multi-source location error and simulation study based on MUSIC algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Symposium on Sensor Technology and Control (ISSTC)
abstract: In the acoustic sensor arrays used for lightning observations, even small deviations between the actual and theoretical microphone positions may result in large relative offset errors of the actual microphone coordinates to the $x, y$, and z axes, leading to location errors, which in turn have a great impact on the accurate reproduction of lightning channel development. In this paper, we first derive the theoretical calculation method of the acoustic source location error generated by the position deviation of array elements based on the MUSIC (Multiple Signal Classification) multi-source location algorithm, and then we conduct experimental test by receiving and simulating the thunder acoustic source with a 16 -element spherical microphone array. Subsequently, the measured location results are obtained by MUSIC algorithm and the sources of errors are analyzed, and it is found that microphone position deviation is the main cause of the measured errors. Then the simulation is conducted using MATLAB and the error variation pattern between the obtained results and the measured results is consistent. The results of this paper show that, compared with the effect of array element position deviation on azimuth, it has a greater effect on the source pitch angle location, and the error in pitch angle should be modified in real measurements.

articleTitle: Intelligent Water Saving Irrigation System Based on Moisture Sensors and Modelling
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Symposium on Sensor Technology and Control (ISSTC)
abstract: To address the problem of water scarcity in the Huang-Huai-Hai region, this study proposed an intelligent water-saving irrigation control system based on soil moisture sensors and modeling technology. In this study, the irrigation system consists of irrigation model and hardware. Irrigation amount calculation models were developed using soil components and sensor data as model input based on the soil-plant-atmosphere continuum’s water transport and balance mechanism. Hardware includes functional modules such as irrigation and head control, and the core controller, developed using a microcontroller, controls the equipment and interacts with the data through multiple communication buses. In the irrigation control process, the irrigation head system uses core controller to manage the peripheral electrical equipment and frequency converter, achieving precise control of the head facilities and equipment. The rotational irrigation zone control employs power line carrier waves and LoRa wireless communication to send commands to solenoid valves and other devices for switching between rotational zones. The results showed that, compared with the local traditional irrigation method, wheat yield under this system increased by 8.41%, and maize yield increased by 0.99%. This novel irrigation system can improve irrigation water use efficiency and promote the sustainable development of agriculture.

articleTitle: Device optimized simulation for Silicon-Based MEMS Piezoresistive Pressure Sensors
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Symposium on Sensor Technology and Control (ISSTC)
abstract: In this research, we have developed a comprehensive simulation project that integrates force-electric coupling to examine the impact of multiple variables on MEMS pressure sensor performance. The project’s distinctive feature is its ability to automatically process various input parameters within a specified tolerance range, swiftly displaying post-processing results that aid in structural optimization. Based on the outcomes of our simulations, we developed a piezoresistive sensor featuring a membrane that measures $200 \mu \mathrm{~m} \times 200 \mu \mathrm{~m} \times 3 \mu \mathrm{~m}$ and piezoresistors sized $24 \mu \mathrm{~m} \times 5 \mu \mathrm{~m}$. The designed sensor demonstrates a sensitivity of $0.494 \mathrm{~mV} / \mathrm{kPa}$ and a non-linearity of 0.0039% FS. The simulated sensitivity result is coordinated with the experimental device outputs and the non-linearity result is much better than the device. After post optimization, the device’s sensitivity is enhanced by 13.3%. This simulation study stands as a testament to the potential of simulation in advancing MEMS technology, paving the way for more sophisticated and efficient sensor designs.

articleTitle: Integrated MOS Bootstrap Circuit Based on 600V High-Voltage BCD Process
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Symposium on Sensor Technology and Control (ISSTC)
abstract: This paper presents an in-depth investigation of the bootstrap circuit for high-voltage gate driver chips, based on a $600 \mathrm{~V} 3 \mu \mathrm{~m}$ BCD process, with the objective of enhancing the overall performance of high-voltage integrated circuits (HVIC). Conventional bootstrap circuits suffer from issues such as poor reliability, low integration, and high costs. In response to these challenges, this work designs an integrated MOS bootstrap circuit to replace the conventional bootstrap diode scheme. Through the first HVIC chip tape-out, it was observed that the bootstrap voltage only reached 12 V, falling short of the expected 15V. To address this issue, the paper proposes a charge-pump boosted control MOS bootstrap circuit, which successfully resolves the insufficient charging problem in traditional bootstrap circuits.

articleTitle: Disposal Method for Left and Right Angle of Attack Difference of Civil Aircraft Stall Protection System
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Symposium on Sensor Technology and Control (ISSTC)
abstract: The angle of attack (AOA) sensor is a special equipment for measuring the AOA of aircraft, which is widely used in various civil aviation models [1]. The AOA sensor of civil aircraft, as an important sensing equipment of stall protection system, measures the AOA of aircraft by sensing airflow. The sensor is cross-linked with stall protection computer (SPC), and the primary sensor data is processed into corrected AOA and sent to avionics system, stick shaker, pitch servo and other components through data bus. So as to realize the functions of stall protection alarm, stall push rod and automatic ignition. In this paper, the difference between left and right angles of attack of stall protection system is analyzed, and the common treatment methods are given for the difference between left and right angles of attack of civil aircraft stall protection system.

articleTitle: Research on Relative Position Testing Based on Inertial Navigation and Ultra-Wideband Fusion System
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Symposium on Sensor Technology and Control (ISSTC)
abstract: Aiming at the challenge that the direction of cable force is difficult to be measured directly in helicopter flight test with slung-load, the inertial navigation and ultra-wideband integration method is used to measure the relative position of slung-load and body, so the direction can be measured indirectly. This paper studies the technology of improving the positioning accuracy of fusion system from three aspects: time registration, base station layout and anti-interference. The results indicate that the label positioning accuracy is higher when the base station is arranged in a circular pattern; by designing registers and using the least squares method, time alignment of the two data sources in the fusion system can be achieved; inertial navigation data correction of ultra-wideband data can improve its positioning accuracy. Experimental data shows that the accuracy of the fusion system can meet the requirements for testing the relative position of the slung-load.

articleTitle: The Simulation Study of Miro-Inductor Based Planar Spiral MEMS Coil Arrays
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Symposium on Sensor Technology and Control (ISSTC)
abstract: The miniaturization of portable electronic devices has driven the demand for smaller electronic components. Traditional inductors limited by conventional manufacturing processes was hard to achieve both small size and high inductance. and are limited by conventional manufacturing processes. Recently, with MEMS technology developing, it is possible to fabricate of high-performance micro-inductor. This paper was aim to design a high-performance micro-inductor based on a planar spiral MEMS coil array. The structure was analyzed and optimized by simulation. The simulation results show that with optimized parameters, the designed micro-inductor significantly improves in inductance value and maximum current-carrying capacity, meeting the application needs of electronic products.

articleTitle: A 2.5D SLAM Algorithm Based on the Fusion of 2D LiDAR and RGB-D Camera
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Symposium on Sensor Technology and Control (ISSTC)
abstract: In multi-sensor fusion SLAM systems, the integration of 2D LiDAR and RGB-D camera point clouds often yields promising results. This paper employs progressive morphological filtering techniques to process the point cloud data generated by the RGB-D camera, effectively filtering out ground points and preventing the misclassification of ground surfaces as obstacles during the fusion of camera and LiDAR point clouds, thereby improving the accuracy of environmental perception. Additionally, a global point cloud processing strategy is adopted to retain key and stable camera points that remain consistent across different perspectives, enhancing the system’s robustness and localization accuracy in dynamic environments. By fusing data from these two types of sensors, the system achieves more reliable environmental perception and map construction.

articleTitle: Impact Experiment Study on Testing Characteristics of PVDF Piezoelectric Sensors
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Symposium on Sensor Technology and Control (ISSTC)
abstract: In order to elucidate the dynamic testing properties of polyvinylidene fluoride (PVDF) piezoelectric film sensors and improve the accuracy of stress wave measurements at the interfaces of porous media, such as aluminum foam, subjected to explosive or impact loads using PVDF piezoelectric sensors, impact experiments were performed utilizing the Hopkinson pressure bar to examine the response characteristics of PVDF piezoelectric film sensors under diverse testing scenarios. The analysis of PVDF sensor responses across various testing conditions yielded the following observations: When compared to an external resistance of $\mathbf{3 5. 9 5} \Omega$, the sensor exhibited a smoother voltage curve and a higher voltage value when the external resistance was set to $554.9 \Omega$. This led to an enhanced signal-to-noise ratio and reduced measurement error within the testing system. Regardless of the placement of a thin aluminum sheet between the incident bar and the sensor or between the sensor and the transmission bar, the original voltage waveform measured by the sensor and the electric charge waveform derived through transformation were highly similar to those obtained without the thin aluminum sheet. The inclusion of the thin aluminum sheet had no discernible impact on the stress test results. The research findings can serve as a valuable reference for the practical engineering applications of PVDF piezoelectric film sensors.

articleTitle: Tunable semiconductor laser spectrum boiler internal gas detection system
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Symposium on Sensor Technology and Control (ISSTC)
abstract: CO and $\mathrm{H}_{2} \mathrm{~S}$ are an important part of the atmosphere in coal-fired boiler furnace. Their concentration can not only reflect the combustion condition, but also be used as the basis for judging the degree of high temperature corrosion of water wall. Therefore, it is of great significance to realize the accurate measurement of CO and $\mathrm{H}_{2} \mathrm{~S}$ concentration. This paper presents a high sensitivity real-time detection system of internal gas based on tunable semiconductor laser absorption spectroscopy technology, using optical communication band fiber coupling near infrared distribution feedback (DFB) semiconductor laser as the light source, using the modulation frequency technology to realize the internal signature gas CO, $\mathrm{H}_{2} \mathrm{~S}$, the minimum detection limit of CO is about 1 ppm, which can meet the needs of internal gas detection in the furnace.

articleTitle: CEEMDAN-STimesnet: A Deep Learning Model for Low Earth Orbit Satellite Trajectory Prediction
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Symposium on Sensor Technology and Control (ISSTC)
abstract: In the trajectory prediction of low Earth orbit (LEO) satellites, orbital height serves as a critical metric. We employ the CEEMDAN-STimes -Net deep learning model to forecast the orbital height of LEO satellites for the next 36 hours. By utilizing CEEMDAN, the orbital height is decomposed into several subsequences, effectively separating the trend components of the data. The model integrates spatial attention with TimesNet, innovatively transforming one-dimensional time series into multi-cycle two-dimensional tensors, ensuring the efficient extraction of historical information. The introduction of spatial attention enhances the model’s emphasis on salient spatial features within the two-dimensional channels. Experimental results demonstrate that compared to the Transformer and its variants, the model achieves a 57.55% reduction in Mean Squared Error (MSE) and a 43.93% reduction in Mean Absolute Error (MAE), offering a novel perspective for trajectory prediction.

articleTitle: High Efficient Recognition and Docking of Mobile Robot for Multiple Trapezoidal Shelves
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Symposium on Sensor Technology and Control (ISSTC)
abstract: Recognition and docking technology of mobile robot is becoming increasing important in the production and manufacture factory. It is necessary to identify the position of shelves efficiently and perform docking accurately. In this paper, we design a recognition method for trapezoidal shelf based on geometric information and a multiple model shelf screening method, which can autonomously identify and dock trapezoidal shelves quickly and accurately. During the recognition process, we combine odometry to eliminate abnormal recognition results and smooth the results. The experiment shows that the method proposed can identify the pose of the trapezoidal shelves efficiently, and the docking accuracy can achieve $\pm 1 \mathrm{~cm}$.

articleTitle: PV MPPT control based on Multi-strategy Sparrow Search Algorithm : PV MPPT control based on MSSA
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Symposium on Sensor Technology and Control (ISSTC)
abstract: Maximum power tracking, as a key technology component in photovoltaic power generation technology, is a current research hotspot. The Multi-strategy Sparrow Search Algorithm (MSSA) proposed in this paper can be well applied to Maximum Power Point Tracking (MPPT) under the shading condition, which has a wide range of application prospects.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Inspection Technology of Transmission Lines by Unmanned Aircraft Based on Multi-sensing
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Symposium on Sensor Technology and Control (ISSTC)
abstract: This paper discusses the intelligent inspection technology of transmission line for UAV based on multi-sensor. Under the condition that the battery energy of UAV is limited, the methods of task allocation and joint trajectory optimisation are investigated, aiming at optimising the inspection path under the limit of battery energy, so that the UAV can efficiently and completely realise the inspection of the line. In the paper, the Kmeans++ algorithm is first used to assign tasks to the UAVs and determine the towers to be inspected by each UAV. Then the improved simulated annealing algorithm is used to optimise the UAV trajectory to ensure that the UAV completes the inspection task under the single flight constraint. Simulation experiments verify the effectiveness of the proposed method, and the results show that the method can obtain a better solution and improve the inspection efficiency.

articleTitle: Anomaly Detection for Slowly Varying Analog Telemetry Data of Spacecraft Based on Autoencoder
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Symposium on Sensor Technology and Control (ISSTC)
abstract: Spacecraft test stage faces a large number of slowly varying analog telemetry data, such as temperature telemetry value and so on. The traditional method based on the upper and lower threshold is difficult to effectively detect the slow changing trend of the data, but the manual labeling method for anomaly detection has high labor cost and poor consistency. In view of the fact that there are few or no labels for abnormal data of slowly varying analog telemetry data and its structural characteristics,an anomaly detection method of telemetry data using auto-encoder is proposed in this paper. Firstly, an autoencoder is trained by historical data, and then the trained auto-encoder encodes and decodes the verification data to realize restoration and reconstruction. Finally, through adaptive threshold discrimination method, the deviation between the reconstructed data and the original data is detected. Experiments are carried out on the telemetry data of the temperature sensor of a spacecraft, and the results show that the proposed method has the ability of anomaly detection.

articleTitle: Research on the Sensor Adaptation Method for Power System based on the Dianhong IOT Operating System
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Symposium on Sensor Technology and Control (ISSTC)
abstract: Due to the difference in the actual operation status of power systems, the sensor and its adaptation directly affect the overall frequency response deviation of the system. Therefore, a research on the sensor adaptation method of power systems based on the Internet of Things operating system of Dianhong is proposed. After analyzing the sensor adaptation requirements of power system from the perspectives of power system requirements, sensor type selection, sensor performance requirements, sensor interface and compatibility, cost and maintenance, the data of sensors is converted into a format that can be recognized by the platform by using the Internet of Things operating system of Dianhong, and the sensor data transmission protocol is defined to adjust the sensor adaptation based on demand. In the test results, not only the frequency response deviation of the tested power system is always stable within 0.2 Hz, but also the frequency of response deviation is obviously low.

articleTitle: Fault Simulation Method of UAV Flight Control Sensor Based on Hardware-in-the-loop Simulation
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Symposium on Sensor Technology and Control (ISSTC)
abstract: Hardware-in-the-loop simulation technology plays an important role in the flight performance and safety test of UAV flight control system. The hardware-in-the-loop simulation method can excavate the potential faults of the flight control system, optimize and adjust the flight control algorithm in time, and lay a foundation for ensuring the safety of outfield flight. In this paper, a hardware-in-the-loop simulation based fault injection method for UAV flight control sensor was proposed. Mathematical models and fault mechanism models of flight control sensors such as gyroscope, accelerometer and magnetometer were constructed. The UAV body model and sensor fault simulation model were established in Simulink environment to form a hardware-in-the-loop simulation system. The sensor fault injection test based on flight control hardware in the loop simulation was carried out. The test results showed that the built flight control hardware in the loop simulation system could effectively simulate the flight control sensor fault and test the flight performance of the flight control sensor under the condition of failure.

articleTitle: Research on Algorithms for Calibration of Laser Scanning Projection System
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Symposium on Sensor Technology and Control (ISSTC)
abstract: The calibration process of laser scanning projection system requires accurate positioning of cooperative targets and precise calculation of coordinate transformation equations. Therefore, this study analyzed the main causes of projection distortion in laser scanning projectors based on a dual-axis galvanometer, established a corresponding mathematical model, optimized the coordinate transformation equation used for calibration, and studied the use of an adaptive weight particle swarm optimization algorithm for its calculation. Meanwhile, the study also explored the Otsu-optimized Canny operator and combined it with the Delaunay triangulation algorithm to process the scanning detection data of cooperative targets and quickly extract their center coordinates. The comprehensive application of these algorithms was experimentally validated using actual measurement data, and the results indicated that the deviation of the calculated calibration parameters was $1.631 \times 10^{-4} \mathrm{~mm}$.

articleTitle: Flexible Wearable Enzyme-free Sweat Glucose Sensor from Au/Pt@MXene
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Symposium on Sensor Technology and Control (ISSTC)
abstract: Absrtact-At present, most blood glucose detection methods are invasive, but this invasive collection method will cause great pain to patients. A large number of studies have shown that the glucose concentration in sweat is correlated with the glucose concentration in blood, and sweat glucose detection has advantages of non-invasive, convenient and continuous compared with blood glucose detection.Bimetal Au/Pt@MXene was synthesized by the synergistic action of bimetal as catalyst for the preparation of glucose sensor. Cyclic voltammetry was used to optimize the ratio of $\mathbf{A u} / \mathbf{P t}$ to obtain the optimal ratio for sweat glucose detection. Cyclic voltammetry, differential voltammetry, timing current method, electrochemical impedance spectroscopy and other electrochemical methods were used to obtain a good linear relationship in the concentration range of $0-11 \mathrm{~mm}$ Glu. The sensitivity reached $13.114 \mu \mathrm{~A} \cdot \mathrm{mmol}{ }^{1 \cdot} \cdot \mathrm{~cm}^{-2}$, and the lowest term stability and anti-interference.

articleTitle: Research on Unwinding Tension Control of Lithiumion Battery Stacking Machine Based on Sliding Mode Control
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Symposium on Sensor Technology and Control (ISSTC)
abstract: Tension control is a key technology to ensure the high-precision and efficient manufacturing of lithium-ion batteries. The tension control of the separator unwinding section of the lithium-ion battery stacking machine is very challenging due to the time-dependent coil radius and errors in coil radius estimation. To this end, the tension model of separator unwinding section was constructed and a sliding mode control (SMC) strategy was adopted, which is combined with the extended state observer (ESO) to compensate the coil radius perturbation and achieve tension stability of separator unwinding section. The effect of tension control was tested on the experimental platform. The results show that compared with the conventional variable proportional control strategy, the designed sliding mode control strategy is more robust in the tension control and more adaptable to the condition of coil radius perturbation. In view of the fact that the traditional variable proportion control strategy can not guarantee the tension fluctuation at ± 5%, the designed sliding mode control strategy can control the tension fluctuation within the range of $-4.1 \% \sim+4.8 \%$ at different coil radius.

articleTitle: An Improved Multi-Sensor Geolocation Method Using Periodic Constraint With Incomplete TOA Measurements
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Symposium on Sensor Technology and Control (ISSTC)
abstract: Limited by the beam scanning characteristics of the emitter, it is usually difficult for multiple receivers to achieve good reception of the same emitter target at the same time. This brings difficulties to multi-sensor time difference of arrival (TDOA) localization. Recent research shows that by introducing the constraint of signal periodicity, high-precision localization can be achieved under incomplete measurements. However, this method does not make full use of all observations, and its heuristic strategy increases the complexity and uncertainty of the algorithm. In this paper, an improved multi-sensor geolocation method is proposed, which makes full use of all the observations and has better positioning accuracy than the traditional methods. In addition, for signals without periodicity, the proposed method can be directly converted into the classical multi-sensor TDOA geolocation method, instead of reprocessing. Theoretical analysis and numerical simulation show that the proposed method achieves better performance than the traditional method.

articleTitle: Application of 3D Phased Array Technology Based on Manufacturing Supervision and Inspection of Catalytic Cracking Unit
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Symposium on Sensor Technology and Control (ISSTC)
abstract: As an important device to realize the conversion of heavy oil to light-end products, the quality of welded joints in the installation stage of catalytic cracking unit is very important. However, in the process of pressure pipeline installation, due to the site restrictions and the influence of the process direction, the pipeline butt weld can not be all X-ray inspection, and can not meet the quality requirements of supervision inspection. In this paper, the applicability of 3D phased array detection technology is discussed through the practical application of pressure pipeline detection in catalytic cracking unit under construction in a petrochemical plant. The results show that the method can make up for the weak link of weld detection in the complex structure and confined space of the pipeline, and can meet the requirements of supervision and inspection, and has important engineering application value for the start-up and safe and stable operation of the pressure pipeline and the whole device.

articleTitle: Smart Home Somatosensory Interaction Control Based on Metaheuristic Algorithm and Optical Flow Method
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Symposium on Sensor Technology and Control (ISSTC)
abstract: Since smart home somatosensory interaction requires the analysis of dynamic actions, the response effect is difficult to guarantee. To this end, a study on somatosensory interactive control of smart homes based on metaheuristic algorithm and optical flow method is proposed. When using the pyramid layered Lucas-Kanade optical flow method to identify somatosensory interactive actions, the establishment of the pyramid is achieved by recursively downsampling the original interactive action image, and the optical flow is calculated layer by layer from the highest layer downwards, using the previous layer’s, the optical flow result is used as the initial estimate of the current layer, and Lucas-Kanade iterative calculation is performed. The meta-heuristic algorithm - Genetic Algorithm (GA) is introduced, based on the somatosensory interactive action flow field, to accurately match the user’s somatosensory interactive actions with the control instructions of smart home devices to achieve corresponding responses. In the test results, the control of different home devices achieved 100.0% effective response under different gesture speeds.

articleTitle: Application of Ammonia Nitrogen On-Line Monitor Based on Flow Injection
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Symposium on Sensor Technology and Control (ISSTC)
abstract: A method for online monitoring of ammonia nitrogen was developed using flow injection analysis system and the indophenol blue spectrophotometry. This method involves a simple solution of sodium dichloroisocyanurate as a substitute for the traditional sodium hypochlorite solution. The integrated flow injection analysis system was operated with laboratory programming software written in LabVIEW. On the basis of single factor design, various parameters for ammonia nitrogen determination were optimized. The research results showed that the system could determine ammonia nitrogen in river water, with a correlation coefficient of the standard curve reaching $\mathbf{0. 9 9 5 2}$. The recovery rate, precision, and accuracy were high, and it had the advantages of convenience, efficiency, speed, and high degree of automation. This approach is well-suited for both laboratory analysis and real-time monitoring of ammonia nitrogen.

articleTitle: Design of Multi-Channel High Speed Sorting Controller Based on FPGA
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Symposium on Sensor Technology and Control (ISSTC)
abstract: As a core technology in today’s industrialized sorting field, optical sorting technology based on machine vision plays an important role in lean production, quality enhancement, renewable resources, and is widely used in related industries such as agricultural products, Ore sorting, and resource recycling. The performance evaluation of optical sorting technology mainly lies in indicators such as sorting accuracy and production capacity, involving two major core technologies: one is precise image acquisition and sorting recognition algorithms, and the other is high-precision material rejection devices. With the increasing demands for the performance of sorting equipment in industrial production, designing a high-precision and rapid response material rejection system has become a key factor in improving the performance of sorting equipment.
